description: UI shell architecture overhaul: pointer-ops manager, per-area tab managers (topbar/left/right), modal+tooltip manager with panic-guarded panels; floating tool windows migrate into the right-sidebar inspector; tool-descriptions sidebar replaced by tooltips; P0 Phase 0 = gardener_ui_system terrain crash fix + viewport path-point selection fix (eager track-list load)
alignment: P0 UX + P0 STABILITY (user-directed 2026-07-24 in-app findings); user-owned UX pillar per roadmap 2026-07-14
notes: 2026-07-24: created from live user testing — (1) cannot select/manipulate existing path points (ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: viewport_pick track_to_open gate requires path_state.tracks, which only loads while the Data window Paths tab renders; fix = eager-load on petal change); (2) terrain tools crash (gardener_ui_system panic → egui pass poisoned, exit 101; H-C1 = proposals-only terrain_json on config-less petal); (3) always-open tool-descriptions sidebar → tooltips; (4) manager decoupling directive (pointer / per-area tabs / modal).

Absorbs ux_interaction_hardening FR-1..FR-4 (incl. FR-3 gimbal damping — absorbed, not dropped); supersedes tool_inspector_ux Phases 2-6 and reworks its Phase 1 left panel; carries terrain_editor_overhaul's residual viewport-selection acceptance; unblocks pen_curve_tool in-app verification.

5 open questions filed in spec §Open questions await user ratification (Q-1 left rail removal, Q-2 right-sidebar tabs, Q-3 single-click edit entry, Q-4 Data/Map windows stay floating, Q-5 panic-guard UX); Phase 0 is ratification-independent.

2026-07-24: Phase 0 partially landed (local, not committed) — FR-2 point-selection fix DONE (eager track-list load on petal change, viewport_pick.rs::advance_petal_tracking, 7 new tests). FR-1 terrain-tools crash is NOT yet root-caused/fixed in this pass; added the panic_log.rs startup panic-payload hook (fractalengine/src/panic_log.rs) as the diagnostic prerequisite so the next repro attempt captures the actual payload+backtrace to data/panic.log instead of only bevy_egui's opaque 'Encountered a panic in system' + exit 101.

2026-07-24: Q-1..Q-5 RATIFIED (user directive 'Ratify spec 5' = accept all recommended answers; recorded in spec §Ratified decisions). Phases 1-6 IMPLEMENTED via a 4-wave sub-agent swarm (recon → grilling → S1..S5+S3a/S3b) and committed to main (local, atop d29be70 → a731369, 8 commits): FR-3 pointer-operations manager (node_manager/pointer/, claim-priority table, no-bypass claim routing); FR-4/5/6 area managers (ui_shell/{topbar,left_sidebar,right_sidebar}, one-section rail, section-fn seam); FR-9 floating windows dissolved into right-sidebar sections; FR-8 left tool panel retired, rich tooltips from TOOL_DEFS+panel_descriptor, readouts+settings in right Tool section; FR-7 modal manager + catch_unwind panel panic-guard + status-bar error segment. Verified: fe-ui 554 tests pass, clippy -D warnings clean (1.94; 1.97.1 gate run separately), rustfmt clean.

2026-07-24 OPEN ITEMS (track stays in_progress): (a) FR-1 terrain crash still NOT root-caused — panic_log.rs awaits the next in-app repro → data/panic.log. (b) FR-7 guard is INERT under [profile.release] panic='abort' (Cargo.toml:88) — RATIFIED 2026-07-25: KEEP panic='abort' (retain tuned lto=fat/codegen-units=1); the guard is intentionally debug/test-only scaffolding and FR-1 root-cause is the primary terrain-crash remedy. A future decision may flip release to panic='unwind' to make the guard shield in-app. (c) In-app verification USER-GATED — not performed. (d) Right-sidebar guard is coarse (a panic in any section quarantines all 5; per-section granularity is a noted follow-up). (e) NOT pushed until the 1.97.1 clippy gate is confirmed green.
